on-error-continue.doc:name: On Error Continue - System and Unexpected

logger.doc:name: Logger ERROR
logger.message: #["ERROR | correlationId=$(vars.correlationId default correlationId) | batchId=$(vars.inventoryRequest.batchId default vars.inputdata.batchId default "N/A") | eventId=$(vars.inventoryEvent.eventId default "N/A") | flow=$(flow.name) | errorType=$(error.errorType.namespace):$(error.errorType.identifier) | code=$(vars.errorInfo.code) | description=$(error.description default "")"]

logger.doc:name: Logger WARN
logger.message: #["REJECTED | correlationId=$(vars.correlationId default correlationId) | batchId=$(vars.inventoryRequest.batchId default vars.inputdata.batchId default "N/A") | eventId=$(vars.inventoryEvent.eventId default "N/A") | flow=$(flow.name) | errorType=$(error.errorType.namespace):$(error.errorType.identifier) | code=$(vars.errorInfo.code) | description=$(error.description default "")"]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { correlationId: vars.correlationId default correlationId, batchId: vars.inventoryRequest.batchId default vars.inputdata.batchId default null, eventId: vars.inventoryEvent.eventId default null, failedFlow: flow.name, errorType: (error.errorType.namespace default "") ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default ""), failureReason: error.description default "", failedAt: now(), originalPayload: vars.inventoryEvent default vars.inputdata default vars.inventoryRequest default null }

logger.doc:name: Logger DLQ
logger.message: #["DLQ | correlationId=$(vars.correlationId default correlationId) | eventId=$(vars.inventoryEvent.eventId default "N/A") | event sent to ${dlq.queueName}"]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { success: false, errorCode: vars.errorInfo.code, message: vars.errorInfo.message, details: if (vars.errorInfo.status >= 500) "See logs for this correlationId" else (error.description default ""), correlationId: vars.correlationId default correlationId, timestamp: now() }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var results = payload.results default [] --- { batchId: payload.batchId default "N/A", processed: sizeOf(results), accepted: sizeOf(results filter ($.outcome == "ACCEPTED")), stale: sizeOf(results filter ($.outcome == "IGNORED_STALE")), duplicate: sizeOf(results filter ($.outcome == "DUPLICATE")), rejected: sizeOf(results filter ($.outcome == "REJECTED")), versionConflict: sizeOf(results filter ($.outcome == "VERSION_CONFLICT")) }

logger.doc:name: Logger METRIC
logger.message: #["METRIC | correlationId=$(vars.correlationId default correlationId) | batchId=$(vars.batchMetrics.batchId) | processed=$(vars.batchMetrics.processed) | accepted=$(vars.batchMetrics.accepted) | stale=$(vars.batchMetrics.stale) | duplicate=$(vars.batchMetrics.duplicate) | rejected=$(vars.batchMetrics.rejected) | versionConflict=$(vars.batchMetrics.versionConflict)"]
